caption:
The AI built a delivery-slot picker with two radio buttons. Click Morning, click Evening, and both stay selected. Nothing can unselect them.

Look at the card. Radio buttons become one group only when they share a name. Without one, each radio is its own group of one. Checking Evening doesn't uncheck Morning, and a checked radio can't be unchecked by clicking it again.

Add name="slot" to both. Now picking one clears the other, arrow keys move between them, and the form sends slot=am or slot=pm.

Keep each input inside its label, so tapping the word selects it. That matters on a phone.

Source: MDN, input type="radio".
